notes: Positive legal label-claim rule for the 14 official Aloxe-Corton Premier Cru climats. The effective specification permits the listed climat names for both white and red wines meeting Premier Cru production conditions.

aloxe_bivb_spec_2011.authority: Bureau Interprofessionnel des Vins de Bourgogne
aloxe_bivb_spec_2011.title: Cahier des charges de l'AOC Aloxe-Corton homologué par le décret n°2011-1369 du 24 octobre 2011
aloxe_bivb_spec_2011.scope: The effective specification enumerates 14 climat names and authorizes their use under Premier Cru production conditions for white and red still wine.

rules.notes: All 14 enumerated Premier Cru climats are valid for both white and red Aloxe-Corton when the corresponding Premier Cru production specification is satisfied.
